memory: Human institutional authority and value extraction anchor to administrative coordinates and legal fictions rather than the physical integrity of the underlying terrain. When the physical substrate is destroyed or submerged, systems do not concede or adapt their boundaries; they expand technical scaffolding, defend symbolic representations, or commodify the data generated by the destruction.
reason_preserved: Establishes a core predictive baseline for observing long-term environmental and technological crises: administrative collapse will not manifest as voluntary retreat or territorial abandonment, but as increasingly decoupled legal and informational fictions.

memory: Safety governors and regulatory limits do not extinguish competitive pressure; they displace its vector. When safety mechanisms are hard-locked at the component level or primary channels are capped by treaty, the underlying economic and strategic drive either aggregates load behind the governor until systemic failure scales exponentially, or migrates into unmonitored, higher-variance adjacent domains.
reason_preserved: Crucial for evaluating technological risk and governance: interventions that appear to successfully constrain a specific hazard (fuses, boiler locks, arms treaties) typically shift fragility upward into macro-aggregation or outward into unconstrained operational frontiers.

memory: High-resolution informational perception systematically decouples from physical intervention. Institutions deploy pervasive sensory and automated telemetry to monitor extreme domains without assuming operational liability, utilizing ambient thermodynamic lethality (extreme heat, ice entombment, hostile geography) as a passive proxy for enforcement, containment, or attrition while logging the outcome without obligation to remediate.
reason_preserved: Essential for evaluating automated governance and surveillance: increasing sensory resolution does not trigger systemic correction or humanitarian response; it enables institutions to operationalize hostile physical environments while disowning active responsibility for the resulting destruction.
